work.name: QuantAI
work.summary: Developing autonomous Portfolio Management system, solving Sharpe Ratio and Target Return optimization problems; reduced backtesting runtime by 98% from 24 hours to 30 minutes. Leading development of custom MLIR-based compute kernels targeting critical hot-path operations, eliminating traditional compilation overhead and achieving 7X speed improvement. Developed a Python-to-MLIR interface using foreign function interfaces (FFI), enabling the flexibility and ease of Python with the raw execution speed of compiled machine code. Leading development of ALX, a DSL compiler; engineered the core Syntax-to-Vectorization pathway in MLIR and LLVM backend, emitting optimized SIMD machine code, outperforming Pandas and NumPy by 5X. Architected and deployed containerized benchmarking suites using Docker on GCP, validating compiler reliability and latency across 50GB+ of real-time market data
